quarterly_data.quarter: Anthropic press release: Singapore office and government MOU (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Anthropic opened a new office in Singapore, its fifth in the Asia-Pacific region, and signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Singapore Ministry of Digital Development and Information (cooperation on AI safety, security and model evaluation, research on AI adoption, responsible adoption across the public and private sectors). The company says Singapore ranks second of 121 countries in Claude.ai usage relative to its population; more than 1,500 engineers and technical staff at GovTech Singapore have adopted Claude Code; DBS works with Claude across use cases in its Singapore operations; GIC is rolling out Claude across its investment and corporate services teams; Grab powers its BriX sales assistant with Claude (saving its sales teams approximately 40,000 hours every quarter); Sea uses Claude for Shopee's customer service chatbot; Supabase is building with Claude Code; regulated-sector organizations can now run Claude with in-region inference on Amazon Bedrock.
quarterly_data.figure: fifth Asia-Pacific office; more than 1,500 GovTech Singapore engineers on Claude Code; approximately 40,000 hours saved every quarter (Grab)
